review.rationale: The supplied Gold is a coherent independent planning expectation for the original PRD and frozen inputs. REQ-001 and AC-001–AC-003 consistently require live, read-only wrapper counts backed by the existing limiter, preserving Promise, scheduling, and clearQueue behavior. The supplied source establishes index.js and index.d.ts as maintained implementation/declaration owners, with test.js and index.test-d.ts as the appropriate regression scopes; package.json confirms the xo && ava && tsd verification entry point and supplies no declaration-generation build evidence. The exact four-file binding scope permits necessary work without requiring gratuitous edits. TASK-IMPLEMENT and dependent, independent TASK-VERIFY are consistent with the specification's required implementation and verification coverage. Neither task has an eligible execution member: the sole project member is a non-auto-assignable reviewer with no capability claims. That reviewer can satisfy the stated earlier independent-review prerequisite without becoming an executor. Consequently, reaching assignments and blocking with abstained-no-eligible for both task keys is appropriate. No unresolved material DEC-001 or B/C scenario is present in this case; no human decision is inferred. Repository identity, base commit, stable keys, evidence stages, and the supplied repository/source/team/decision/prompt/model/sampling/policy release fingerprints are consistent between Gold and preview. Digests are accepted as Service-calculated bindings, not independently recomputed. This approval concerns the pre-candidate Gold expectation only; it does not attest to execution, task dispatch, or completion of the outstanding negative controls.
